import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_3.csv"
]

# Mapping of source label strings to target integer labels
label_mapping = {
    'purple': 1,
    'b': 1,
    'g': 1,
    'r': 1
}

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Convert 'label' column from string to integer using the mapping
    # If any label not in mapping, raise error to avoid silent issues
    if not df['label'].isin(label_mapping.keys()).all():
        unknown_labels = df.loc[~df['label'].isin(label_mapping.keys()), 'label'].unique()
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown label values found in {file_path}: {unknown_labels}")
    df['label'] = df['label'].map(label_mapping)
    
    # Convert 'y' column to integer by rounding (since target schema expects integer)
    # Source 'y' is float, target 'y' is integer
    df['y'] = df['y'].round().astype(int)
    
    # Ensure 'x' is float (should already be, but enforce)
    df['x'] = df['x'].astype(float)
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df = df[['x', 'y', 'label']]
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Union all source DataFrames (concatenate)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
